changelog:
Initial release of the forget-something skill—implements configurable memory forgetting strategies for AI systems.

- Supports time-based, relevance-based, frequency-based, context-based, and explicit forgetting strategies.
- Provides code examples for configuring and invoking forgetting mechanisms.
- Includes OpenClaw-specific integration and scheduler setup.
- Offers manual forgetting options by memory ID or topic.
- Documentation includes usage examples and best practices for safe deployment.
summary: Implement forgetting mechanisms for AI systems to manage memory overload, improve performance, and maintain data privacy. Use when working with long-term AI...
